comment: Every fix branch composed into conformance-build, with the tip last reconciled with it. The build workflow fails when a tip on the fork no longer matches, because the tarball is built from this branch alone: work added to a fix branch after its merge is absent from the release and nothing else reports it. Ancestry cannot stand in for this, because several branches were squashed after being composed and later phases rewrote the same code, so their tips are not ancestors although their content is present. Update a sha in the same commit that merges the new work, never on its own. The phase field says which phase owns the branch. A single small fix belongs to phase 1, which is the small-fixes phase, whether or not the phase 1 plan enumerated it: that plan was a snapshot of the first nine. Null is for work that predates the phases.
